meta.title: NM traductions · Neda Mesgari, sworn Farsi, Dari and French translator-interpreter
meta.description: Sworn translations from Farsi and Dari into French, and from French into Farsi and Dari. Interpreting services in Belgium: civil status records, residence documents, legal documents and diplomas.

hero.lead: Sworn translations between Farsi, Dari and French, in both directions, and interpreting for public services, lawyers and individuals in Belgium.

about.title: Precision from one language to another, with the rigour official documents demand.
about.p1: My name is Neda Mesgari. As a sworn translator and interpreter, I support public services, lawyers, social services and individuals with their procedures in Belgium. I faithfully translate your documents from Farsi and Dari into French, and from French into Farsi and Dari.
about.p2: Every translation is a document with consequences: one misspelt name or one wrongly converted date, and an entire file is delayed. I work methodically and in strict confidence, so your documents are accepted the first time.

sworn.title: Sworn
sworn.text: Registered in the Belgian National Register of sworn translators and interpreters.

confidential.title: Confidential
confidential.text: Professional secrecy guaranteed for every document and every conversation.

precise.title: Meticulous
precise.text: Names, dates and official wording carefully rendered and checked.

services.title: Translations public authorities can rely on
services.intro: All my translations can be delivered as sworn translations, ready to be submitted to Belgian public authorities.

civil.title: Civil status
civil.text: Birth, marriage and divorce certificates, death certificates, identity documents and household composition records.

residence.title: Residence & asylum
residence.text: Documents for the Immigration Office, the CGRS, family reunification and nationality applications.

legal.title: Legal
legal.text: Judgments, powers of attorney, contracts, criminal record extracts and notarial deeds.

education.title: Diplomas & education
education.text: Diplomas, transcripts and certificates for recognition applications and enrolments.

medical.title: Medical & administrative
medical.text: Medical reports, certificates, official letters and everyday documents.

interpreting.title: Interpreting
interpreting.text: Spoken Farsi/Dari ↔ French support at hearings and at appointments with public services, doctors or lawyers.

languages.title: Between Persian and French, with nothing lost along the way.

expertise.title: Two variants, one standard of precision
expertise.text: Farsi and Dari are two variants of Persian, but their administrative vocabulary differs. Proper names, dates from the Persian calendar, official titles: every detail is rendered accurately.

bullets.dates: Conversion of dates from the Persian calendar
